wholePhysicalScope: The exact native ring spans approximately 216 by 78 metres and controls the central block, projecting north and south frontages, lateral galleries and end pavilions.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the long three-range palace, garden portico and central cupola. Near views refine the tapered columns, verandas and window sashes.
limitations: Roof ridges, window and column cadence away from the photographed façade, exact condition of the far wings and absolute floor elevations are medium-fidelity approximations.
This is the standing palace and its connected ranges. The detached Balai Kirti building, the botanical estate, interiors, fences and gardens are outside the exterior scope.
